preferred_lead: Heavy rain through October with no dry days and a late cool-down
lesson: When rain falls every day, say that persistence directly.

preferred_lead: Extreme rain on May 20 broke a hot dry start to the week
lesson: If one day dominates the week, lead with that day.

preferred_lead: Dry spell from Oct 13-25 with just 1mm versus 58mm expected
lesson: For dry windows, pair duration with the rainfall shortfall.

preferred_lead: Two-week heat wave with highs and lows more than 3°C above normal
lesson: When heat dominates, keep the framing on heat.

preferred_lead: Winter warm spell kept minimum temperatures about 4°C above normal despite rain
lesson: If rain fails to cool Bangalore, that contrast is worth stating.

preferred_lead: Unseasonal heavy rain made for a cool March with highs 5°C below normal
lesson: Temperature impact can matter more than the rainfall total itself.

preferred_lead: Cold nights after Oct 27 left lows about 3.5°C below expected
lesson: When cold and dryness coexist, lead with the more interesting one.

preferred_lead: Record-high temperatures dominated this hot dry November stretch
lesson: If record days cover most of the window, records come first.

lesson: Do not call it sustained accumulation when 1-2 days explain most of the anomaly.

lesson: Monthly totals are the right lead when the signal is genuinely cumulative.
